ai.name: Anthropic (via FT)
ai.hook: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue jumped nearly 50% to $16.8bn before IPO.
insights: Q1 revenue was around **$4.8bn**, so the year has roughly tripled in three quarters
The numbers were briefed to investors at a hosted day, not in an official filing
An **IPO** is now being openly framed as the next step
ai.for_you: Enterprise AI spend is not a bubble narrative you need to defend in sales calls: use the $16.8bn quarter as the single number that answers the Portuguese SMB objection 'isto é moda passageira'. It also means Claude pricing is unlikely to drop, so budget the agency's margin on a cheaper default model and reserve Claude for client-facing quality work.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Only hard financial datapoint on the AI market today, and it is a sales objection killer.

ai.name: Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt, Qing Wang
ai.hook: Anthropic replaces the code review gate with continuous AI review, like spellcheck.
insights: They reject '**did a human read the code?**' as an imprecise proxy for safety
Review now runs **continuously while writing**, not as a PR gate at the end
Most changes are reviewed and fixed by Claude at least once before any human looks
ai.for_you: This is the single most useful process to copy as a non-developer shipping real products: wire a Claude review step into your yoga platform repo so your AI-written code gets critiqued before you, who cannot yet spot a subtle bug, hit deploy. It converts your technical gap from a blocker into a workflow step.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Most directly transferable working practice for a PM who ships AI-written code.

ai.name: Nathan Lambert
ai.hook: Meta's open-weight release puts US open models back at the frontier.
insights: Lambert argues **US open weights are back** after a year of Chinese labs leading
He separately testified to Congress on the **balance of power in open models**
His parallel post argues progress will be rapid but **jagged**, not general superintelligence
ai.for_you: For the agency this matters commercially: a credible US open-weight frontier model means you can offer Portuguese SMBs on-premise or EU-hosted deployments without the 'modelo chinês' objection, which is the quietest killer in RGPD-sensitive deals with law firms and clinics.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Best analysis framing of the open-weights shift rather than another release announcement.

ai.name: Latent Space / AINews
ai.hook: Agents reportedly disprove polysemanticity, cracking open interpretability and alignment.
insights: **Nick Cammarata** makes the claim, using agents as the research instrument rather than the subject
If it holds, individual neurons map more cleanly to single concepts than assumed
It is a second datapoint on **agents doing real research work**, after the Navier-Stokes claim
ai.for_you: No direct action for the agency, but file the pattern: agents are now the cheapest way to run many parallel experiments on a hard question. You can borrow the shape at tiny scale by running 20 agent variations of a sales email or onboarding flow for one SMB client instead of hand-writing three.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Biggest research claim in the feeds that is not already covered this week.

ai.name: Jack Clark
ai.hook: New benchmark shows models still fail basic intuitive visual reasoning.
insights: **Humanity's Sixth Sense** tests intuitive physical and visual judgement, where models underperform
Clark also flags **open-weight models worse than China's** as a persistent US gap
Same issue covers creativity and recursive self-improvement claims
ai.for_you: Directly relevant to the yoga platform: do not ship any feature that asks a model to judge posture or body alignment from video or photos, the visual reasoning is not there. Keep AI on text, sequencing and personalisation, keep the human teacher on the body.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Only entry today that tells Pedro what NOT to build, which is rarer and more valuable.

ai.name: Hugging Face / Reflection
ai.hook: Beam ships as a 501B open model you can own, customize and scale.
insights: **501B parameters**, positioned explicitly around ownership and customization
Lands alongside **Granite Switch 4.1** from IBM, which serves chat, decisions and speech from one endpoint
Nvidia is simultaneously reported weighing a **Reflection acquihire**
ai.for_you: Granite Switch 4.1 is the one to actually test this week: a single endpoint doing chat plus speech means one integration instead of three for an SMB phone-and-WhatsApp assistant, which is the offer most Portuguese clinics and oficinas actually want to buy.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Only new open-model releases today not already covered in the last 7 days.

ai.name: Simon Willison
ai.hook: Two phones play networked pong over microphone chirps, in static HTML.
insights: Built from a **single prompt**, no server, state transmitted as audio via the Web Microphone API
Runs as plain static HTML on tools.simonwillison.net
He also documents **document.currentScript** to self-replace inline script tags with rendered values
ai.for_you: The lesson for the yoga platform is that serverless, zero-backend prototypes are now a one-prompt afternoon: build a throwaway static page for a guided breathing timer and put it in front of five students this week before you touch infrastructure or auth.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Clearest demonstration this week of prompt-to-shipped-artifact at a scale Pedro can copy.

build_this.name: Claude ECDSA curve origins investigation
build_this.what_it_is: Anthropic used Claude to trace the long-unexplained provenance of the NIST ECDSA curve seeds.
build_this.why_try_it: Read it as a template for an agency service: 'AI-assisted document archaeology' for Portuguese SMBs sitting on 20 years of unsearchable PDFs, contracts and scanned archives. It is a concrete, demo-able offer you can prototype on one client's document folder this week.

build_this.name: Sphinx
build_this.what_it_is: A git hook that quizzes you on the AI-generated code in your commit before it ships.
build_this.why_try_it: Built exactly for your situation: it forces you to actually understand the code Claude writes for the yoga platform instead of merging blind. Install it on one repo today and treat the failed quizzes as your personal learning backlog.

podcasts.episode: First Party Chips and the NVIDIA Price
podcasts.takeaway: Hyperscalers build their own chips mostly as leverage to negotiate NVIDIA's price down.
key_points: Fractile's **Walter Goodwin** argues the custom silicon race is partly a bargaining tactic
First-party chips rarely need to win on performance to be worth building
The implication is inference pricing stays under structural downward pressure
podcasts.for_you: Price your agency retainers assuming model inference costs keep falling, so quote on outcomes and hours saved for the SMB rather than per-token pass-through, or you will be renegotiating down every six months.

video.title: First Party Chips and the NVIDIA Price

tech.name: TechCrunch
tech.hook: Meta strips scraping and AI training language that spooked users from its terms.
tech.key_point: The removed clauses were the ones that implied broad rights to user content for model training.
tech.for_you: Worth tracking as precedent for the data-use clause you put in agency contracts, since Portuguese SMB clients will ask who owns the data their assistant sees.

tech.name: Ars Technica
tech.hook: A New Jersey prosecutor is accused of producing AI-generated CSAM under an alias.
tech.key_point: Police identify 'thegentlemanpervert' as a sitting prosecutor, a severe insider-trust case for generative image tooling.
tech.for_you: If you ever offer image generation to clients, log and gate it: the reputational blast radius of misuse lands on whoever integrated the tool.

tech.name: The Verge
tech.hook: Cities move to regulate and restrict robotaxis on their own streets.
tech.key_point: Local authorities are drafting rules that override permissive state-level autonomous vehicle permits.
tech.for_you: Municipal-level pushback is the pattern to watch before AI services hit Portuguese câmaras, regulation here arrives locally and quietly.

tech.name: Wired
tech.hook: OnlyFans creators object that Meta lets its Muse assistant talk dirty.
tech.key_point: Meta's relaxed content rules on Muse undercut a paid creator market that enforced its own limits.
tech.for_you: A reminder that when platforms loosen AI content policy they absorb adjacent markets overnight, relevant if your yoga platform ever leans on a Meta-owned distribution channel.

tech.name: Wired
tech.hook: Data centre industry courts public goodwill by hosting school field trips.
tech.key_point: Operators are running children's tours as a deliberate PR response to local opposition over power and water use.
tech.for_you: Portugal is actively bidding for data centre investment, so expect the same community-relations playbook, and the same energy debate, in Sines and Moura.

pt_news.headline: Saída antecipada de Lagarde pode reconfigurar o BCE em semanas
pt_news.hook: A Reuters avança que a saída de Christine Lagarde do BCE pode consumar-se já nas próximas semanas, em plena turbulência política francesa.
pt_news.for_you: Mudança na liderança do BCE mexe com as taxas e com o crédito às PME, que é exatamente o orçamento de onde sai o teu retainer de agência.

pt_news.headline: Juros altos tornam obrigações mais apelativas do que ações
pt_news.hook: As yields das dívidas soberanas atingiram níveis não vistos em mais de duas décadas, atraindo investidores para fora das ações.
pt_news.for_you: Com dinheiro barato a render em obrigações, o capital de risco português fica mais exigente: financia as tuas apostas com receita de clientes, não com ronda.

pt_news.headline: Talgo propõe a Portugal comboios de alta velocidade de dupla bitola
pt_news.hook: A fabricante espanhola quer vender a Portugal comboios adaptáveis às duas bitolas ibéricas para a futura rede de alta velocidade.
pt_news.for_you: Grandes contratos ferroviários arrastam cadeias de fornecedores PME em manutenção e logística, um nicho concreto para automação documental da agência.

pt_news.headline: Provedora de Justiça pede explicações à PSP sobre carga no Porto
pt_news.hook: Luísa Neto vai avaliar se a intervenção policial contra manifestantes no Porto respeitou o direito de reunião e manifestação.
pt_news.for_you: Sem ação direta, mas o clima de protesto está a chegar a Portugal vindo de França, com impacto em deslocações e reuniões presenciais com clientes.

video.title: Provedora de Justiça solicita informações urgentes à PSP sobre intervenções no Porto

pt_news.headline: ASF lança questionário sobre satisfação dos consumidores com seguros
pt_news.hook: O regulador quer medir o valor percebido dos produtos de seguros quanto a preço, coberturas e clareza.
pt_news.for_you: Corretores de seguros são o cliente-tipo da tua agência: um regulador a medir insatisfação é o gancho de venda para automatizar respostas e explicação de apólices.

world_news.headline: Macron addresses nation as French protests turn violent
world_news.hook: Macron speaks at 19h Lisbon time after school protests merged with yellow vest anger and over 2,000 arrests.
world_news.for_you: France is Portugal's second-largest trading partner and a huge diaspora market, so sustained unrest there slows any cross-border SMB deals.

world_news.headline: Israeli settlers attack EU diplomats in West Bank
world_news.hook: France demands Israel stop the attacks after video shows settlers confronting a diplomatic convoy near Jerusalem.
world_news.for_you: EU-Israel diplomatic friction is escalating, worth tracking if any client supply chain touches Israeli tech vendors.

world_news.hook: Ukraine says speed restrictions hit its Starlink service while other European countries saw none.
world_news.for_you: A single private vendor throttling a country is the strongest argument yet for keeping client-critical AI workloads on swappable providers.

world_news.hook: Fragmentation on the left damages Pedro Sánchez's chances of staying in office.
world_news.for_you: A government change in Madrid shifts Iberian digital and AI funding programmes that Portuguese SMBs often co-apply to.

world_news.hook: A drone set off an air alert that scrambled NATO fighters before crashing; Ukraine apologised.
world_news.for_you: No direct action, filed for awareness on NATO-flank escalation risk affecting European energy and cloud costs.
